final: WITH mix_counts AS (SELECT t.ordertypedist, COUNT(DISTINCT t.transreg) AS transaction_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON a.translink = t.transreg GROUP BY t.ordertypedist), shares AS (SELECT ordertypedist, transaction_count, 1.0 * transaction_count / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS share FROM mix_counts), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT s.ordertypedist, s.transaction_count, s.share, s.share - b.avg_share AS above_baseline FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE s.share > b.avg_share
